mandate: C410 — test the cross-sectional intraday XCORR: AVERAGE PAIRWISE CO-MOVEMENT / CROSS-SECTIONAL CORRELATION PROFILE x SEASONAL-DISLOCATION mean-reversion stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1296 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|. Return matrix R=(T,10). XCORR scalars over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing returns: for each asset i and bar t, corr_j(t)=Pearson corr(X_i, X_j) over X_i=r_i[t-W+1..t], X_j=r_j[t-W+1..t] for each j!=i (9 pairwise legs); xcorr_mean=(1/9)*sum_{j!=i} corr_j(t) (avg coupling to panel, in [-1,1]); xcorr_disp=std_{j!=i}(corr_j(t)) (unevenness of coupling). Needs indices t-W+1..t (W bars) across the full panel. NaN if t<W or any NaN/non-finite in the W-bar panel span, any pairwise leg has zero variance, or not finite. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 2 real (xcorr_mean_dev, xcorr_disp_dev) + 2 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs and valid denominators; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W-bar panel span or any pairwise leg has zero variance or not finite).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing returns; return matrix R=(T,10) built once; corr_j(t)=Pearson corr(X_i, X_j) over X_i=r_i[t-W+1..t], X_j=r_j[t-W+1..t] for j!=i; xcorr_mean=(1/9)*sum_{j!=i} corr_j; xcorr_disp=std_{j!=i}(corr_j).
methodology.signals: xcorr_mean/xcorr_disp over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1296 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 4 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.xcorr_vectorization_note: return matrix R=(T,10) built once; zero-copy sliding_window_view(R,256) processed in chunks; per-chunk centered sum-identity covariance/correlation (10x10 corr per bar); xcorr_mean=off-diagonal row mean of corr; xcorr_disp=off-diagonal row std (ddof=0) of corr; validated against brute-force per-window loop with explicit np.corrcoef with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests. Chunking keeps peak memory low.
